title: Reconsideration
description: The record that an observation changed the governing state of the system. A reconsideration is triggered by a challenge, a policy review trigger, changed evidence, elapsed time, an incident, or an expansion request, and ends with a stated outcome for the decision, grant, or policy it concerned. Observability without state transition is theater (Law VIII); this object is the state transition.

schema_version.title: Schema version
schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record conforms to.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: The class of event that triggered reconsideration.

ref.title: Reference
ref.description: Identifier of the challenge, review trigger, evidence item, incident, or expansion request.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The object whose validity is being reconsidered.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Whether a decision, a grant, or a policy is being reconsidered.

ref.title: Reference
ref.description: Identifier of the decision record, grant, or policy record.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: What happened to the subject: it stands, is narrowed, suspended, reversed, corrected, or expanded. Pending reconsiderations use pending.

evidence_delta.title: Evidence delta
evidence_delta.description: Plain-language statement of how the evidentiary state changed between the original decision and this reconsideration.

decided_by.title: Decided by
decided_by.description: The accountable person or body that recorded the outcome.

resulting_refs.title: Resulting references
resulting_refs.description: Identifiers of records the outcome produced or changed, such as a new grant version or a decision reversal.
